import cv2
import numpy as np

def enhance_image(img):
    lab = cv2.cvtColor(img, cv2.COLOR_BGR2LAB)
    l, a, b = cv2.split(lab)
    clahe = cv2.createCLAHE(clipLimit=3.0, tileGridSize=(8,8))
    cl = clahe.apply(l)
    limg = cv2.merge((cl,a,b))
    final = cv2.cvtColor(limg, cv2.COLOR_LAB2BGR)
    return final

# Enhance and re-read
vendor_enhanced = enhance_image(cv2.imread('vendor_crop.png'))
items_enhanced = enhance_image(cv2.imread('items_crop.png'))
totals_enhanced = enhance_image(cv2.imread('totals_crop.png'))
